query.sql:
SELECT
  scope.passages AS passages,
  scope.questions AS questions,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE decision.disposition = 'quarantine') AS quarantined,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.matches AS expertMatches,
  expertReview.answerAgreement.total AS expertTotal,
  expertReview.materialAmbiguityCount AS materialAmbiguities
FROM read_json_auto('output/audits/ielts-reading-rights-ynng-2026-08-09/validation.json') AS report,
UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision)
GROUP BY ALL;

SELECT

UNNEST(report.decisions) AS rows(decision);

blocks.body: # IELTS Reading Yes / No / Not Given — audit gate

## Executive Summary

- The F0.2b.3 control passes; the 3 passages do not. All remain quarantined.
- Independent review covered 22/22 statements, matched all stored labels and found 2 material ambiguities.
- A degree-language cue predicts NO on 6 of 11 eligible statements; content certification remains blocked.
- UI/UX and Playwright are outside this audit slice because all four learner-facing hashes are unchanged.

## The dossier passes; the bank is blocked

Hashes pin identity, incomplete rights records fail closed, and candidate evidence remains separate from verification. Matching every stored label is not enough: two statements still admit another reasonable answer, and no author, license, human factual review or human approval is recorded.

## Writer attribution and absence are explicit contracts

YES and NO require a decisive writer-view span; NOT GIVEN requires a related passage zone plus the exact missing claim. The two material ambiguities are ynng-station-art-07, ynng-uniforms-04. They must be rewritten and independently re-adjudicated before release.

## Label counts alone do not certify balance

The stored labels are YES 9, NO 8 and NOT GIVEN 5. The targeted degree-language rule applies to 11 statements and predicts NO correctly on 6 (55%). Sequence, length, lexical overlap, writer verbs and title cues are audited separately.

## Plausible wording is not source verification

The direct-source pass found only two of 13 declared claims supported as written; seven were oversimplified and four untraceable. Candidate institutional sources can contextualize a claim without proving the passage, its authorship or its license.

## The content still exposes useful learning targets

The clean walkthrough traces voice shifts, concessions, conditions, scope and missing claims across all 22 statements. Its value is prospective and diagnostic: it assigns no labels or bands and does not represent a real learner study.

## Panel scope

Applicable lanes pass only for a complete, conservative and reproducible dossier. UI/UX and Playwright are not applicable to this unchanged learner-facing delta; that is not approval of the existing interface.

## Recommended next decisions

1. Rewrite the two materially ambiguous statements and repeat blind adjudication.
2. Reduce title and wording cues, then remeasure the multidimensional shortcut profile.
3. Resolve authorship, rights, exact factual support and independent human review for all three passages.
4. Keep F0.2b open; begin F0.2b.4 only in the next loop iteration.

## Caveats and open questions

The provenance search is directed and non-exhaustive. Source reachability is not verification. Both independent reviews are AI simulations without human signatures. The 22-question sample cannot certify statistical fairness. Runtime quarantine enforcement and learner-facing UI remain separate open units.

audit.scope: Dossier completeness and conservative disposition; not copyright clearance.
audit.findings: 3/3 assets remain unknown-quarantined. A directed non-exhaustive provenance search and eight candidate-source fetches do not establish authorship, ownership or authorization.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: Authorship, rights basis, license or authorization evidence, factual human review and independent human approval remain unresolved.

audit.scope: Identity, fail-closed registry decisions, blind packets, first-pass trace and deterministic validation.
audit.findings: Object and passage hashes match baseline and registry; malformed or changed records quarantine. Recursive guards cover key names, key-like text values and learner/contact PII.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: The local first-pass hash is not an external append-only witness; runtime quarantine enforcement belongs to a later unit.

audit.scope: Complete independent audit of writer-view attribution and answerability; not bank certification.
audit.findings: The reviewer covered 22/22 statements and matched all stored labels, but identified 2 material ambiguities and rated all three passages mixed for IELTS fitness.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: ynng-station-art-07 and ynng-uniforms-04 require rewriting and independent re-adjudication before publication.

audit.scope: Prospective content-only simulation, not a real learner or UI study.
audit.findings: 3/3 passages and 22/22 statements have likely misread, evidence hunt, attribution check, decision rule and repair action recorded without assigned answers or bands.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: No claim of retention, band improvement, accessibility, usability or effectiveness with real students.

audit.scope: Detection and blocking, not statistical fairness certification.
audit.findings: Stored labels are YES=9, NO=8 and NOT GIVEN=5. A degree-language cue hits NO on 6/11 eligible statements; sequence, length, lexical overlap, attribution wording, title and qualitative risks are recorded.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: n=22 is below the certification threshold, two items are materially ambiguous and contentCertification remains blocked.

audit.scope: Not applicable to the learner-facing delta of F0.2b.3 only.
audit.findings: Catalog, route, ObjectivePracticeEngine and ObjectivePracticeSetBank hashes equal the pinned baseline; no app or component imports the audit registry or contract.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: This does not certify the existing UI, accessibility, Task 2 parity, shared layouts or product-wide behavior.

audit.scope: Not applicable because this audit-only unit introduces no scoped DOM, copy, interaction or runtime delta.
audit.findings: The exclusion is guarded by four baseline hashes and absence of audit imports from learner-facing runtime sources.
audit.blockersCarriedForward: No browser matrix, screenshots, traces or viewport evidence exists for this row, so it must never be represented as Playwright PASS.
